messages:
Priya R.: Heads-up — planning a gradual rollout for payments-service v2 tomorrow 09:00 PT. Goal: smoke then cohort ramps. Who can own the deploy + smoke checks?
Jared M.: I can own deployment and initial smoke checks. I'll be online 08:30–10:30 PT.
Maya L.: Proposed ramp: 1% -> 5% (30m) -> 25% (45m) -> 100% (1h). Cohorts: EU first (low traffic), then US-east internal, then global.
Sam K.: Suggest making the dwell times explicit: 1% for 15m, 5% for 30m, 25% for 45m before full. Also add a short validation window after each step to check alerts/latency.
Priya R.: Good call. Smoke checklist (brief):
- curl https://payments.redwood.internal/health (200)
- run `scripts/smoke/payments_smoke.sh` (integration smoke)
- check metric `payments.payment_fail_rate` < 0.5% over 10m
- p50/p99 latency under thresholds (p99 < 800ms)
- no new error-rate alerts firing in Datadog
Jared M.: Deploy steps I'll run: 1) build image (CI) 2) `redwoodctl deploy payments --image=registry/.../payments:v2-rc --strategy=canary --canary-config "[1,5,25]"` 3) `kubectl rollout status deployment/payments -n payments`
Rollback: `redwoodctl rollback payments --to=previous` — I have permissions and will own rollback.
Olivia (deploy-bot): CI note: build job scheduled for 08:50 PT, tag will be rc-20260318-1.
Maya L.: @Sam K. can you watch the dashboards and tracer heatmap? I'll monitor logs/trace for new error classes. Link to dash: https://app.datadog.com/dashboard/payments-ops (pin).
Sam K.: Yup. I'll create an ephemeral watch channel and set to 08:50–11:00 PT. I'll escalate if `payments.payment_fail_rate` > 0.8% or if p99 > 1s. If that happens, I'll call for immediate rollback.
Priya R.: Final assignment: Jared = deploy + rollback owner, Maya = smoke + logs/traces, Sam = metrics/watch + escalation. Start 09:00 PT. Ramp plan updated to 1% (15m) -> 5% (30m) -> 25% (45m) -> 100% (30m). Everyone OK?
Jared M.: Acknowledged. I'll post status at the start/end of each ramp step. If anything weird, I'll cut traffic to last good cohort and run `redwoodctl rollback`.
Maya L.: :thumbsup: I've added the smoke checklist and rollback play to the release doc: https://docs.internal/releases/payments-v2 (private).
deploy-bot: Deployment job queued by Jared M. — CI#34562.
deploy-bot: Deploy started at 1782110000 by Jared M. — canary rollout 1% target.
Jared M.: 1% deployed. Quick smoke: `curl /health` -> 200, `scripts/smoke/payments_smoke.sh` -> 6/6 passed, error rate observed 0.12% (10m), p99 480ms.
Sam K.: Watching — dashboards stable, no alerts yet.
Priya R.: Good. Hold for 15m, then proceed to 5% if still clean.
Jared M.: Will wait and then bump traffic.
Sam K.: All clear from my side so far. Will flag immediately if anything degrades.
Maya L.: Confirmed logs look clean for the last 10m. Proceed with next step when ready.
Jared M.: Proceeding to 5% now. Will update after the dwell window.
